top_signals.title: Neko Health CEO: Using AI Scans & Longitudinal Data for a Longer Life
top_signals.summary:
The CEO of full-body scanner Neko Health says technology could help shift healthcare from treating symptoms to identifying risks earlier.
Hjalmar Nilsonne explains how Neko’s scans combine imaging, cardiovascular testing and blood analysis to build a detailed picture of a person’s health, while repeated scans can create longitudinal data to track changes and uncover deeper patterns over time. Nilsonne predicts that in his lifetime AI and more personalized medicine could ultimately help people stay healthier for longer. He spoke to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Tech: Europe." (Source: Bloomberg)
